categories.main_business_segments: Fu Shou Yuan International Group Limited operates primarily in three business segments: burial services, funeral services, and other services including cemetery and funeral parlour design, construction services, and manufacturing and sales of cremation machines. Burial services constitute the largest revenue share, followed by funeral services and other ancillary services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes digital transformation and green environmental concepts in its funeral and burial services. It integrates AI technology for digital person creation and offers interactive digital ancestral halls. The eco-friendly cremator business involves R&D, design, in-house production, and after-sales service of smart and eco-friendly cremation equipment with exhaust gas purification systems. The company also implements digitized systems for cemetery management and engineering.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Fu Shou Yuan serves individual customers seeking burial plots and funeral services, as well as institutions and governments purchasing pre-need contracts and elderly service solutions. The company targets customers with diverse and differentiated needs, especially those requiring spiritual and emotional services. It also collaborates with insurance companies and elderly service institutions to expand its pre-need contract business.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group operates in over 40 cities across 19 provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities in China, including major regions such as Shanghai, Anhui, Liaoning, Henan, Jiangsu, and others. Shanghai is the largest revenue contributor, accounting for nearly half of total revenue. The company also has subsidiaries and operations in Hong Kong and the British Virgin Islands for investment and technology development purposes.
categories.supply_chain_position: Fu Shou Yuan operates primarily downstream in the death care service supply chain, providing end-to-end funeral and burial services directly to customers. It also engages in midstream activities such as manufacturing cremation equipment and offering design and construction services for funeral facilities, positioning itself as a comprehensive service provider within the death care ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The Group's strategic focus is on digital transformation, green and eco-friendly funeral services, and technology-driven commemorative services. It invests in AI and digital innovations such as digital person virtual events and interactive digital ancestral halls. The company also prioritizes R&D in eco-friendly cremation equipment and promotes integration of Internet technologies with death care services to enhance service quality and accessibility.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through the sale of burial plots, provision of cemetery maintenance services, funeral service arrangements, and sales of related products such as cremation machines. The company also earns income from pre-need contracts, design and construction services, and after-sales services. Revenue recognition occurs at point of sale or over time for maintenance services, with pre-need contracts recognized upon service delivery.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Fu Shou Yuan is positioned as a leading and innovative funeral and life technology service provider in China, recognized for its brand value and technological advancements. It holds a dominant market position with extensive geographic coverage and a comprehensive service portfolio. The company faces competition in local markets but maintains leadership through innovation, digital transformation, and adherence to regulatory standards.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the Group reported revenue of RMB 2,077.5 million and a net profit of RMB 497.3 million, with profit attributable to shareholders at RMB 373.1 million. The revenue decreased by approximately 20.9% compared to the previous year, mainly due to cautious consumer behavior and a high comparative base post-COVID-19. The company operates 34 cemeteries and 31 funeral facilities, with a strong cash position and low gearing ratio of 0.5%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Fu Shou Yuan differentiates itself through its 'People-oriented and Culture-rooted' philosophy, integrating cultural innovation with technology to provide high-quality, multi-layered funeral and life services. Its unique offerings include digital rituals, AI-powered digital ancestral halls, and eco-friendly cremation equipment. The company emphasizes emotional comfort, spiritual services, and environmental sustainability, aiming to transform traditional funeral services into life technology services.
